items.markdown:
Both **No Days Wasted** (such as *No Days Wasted DHM Detox* ) and **Cheers** (such as *Cheers Restore* ) are popular over-the-counter wellness supplements that target post-drinking fatigue and hangovers using similar core active ingredients, though their formulations, timing recommendations, and clinical backing differ.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXX7PEbeNwNj9_cz4cSbq3DmFr9oeUrGaxNR0nOmqy04SAQV3cKsK610bmriVrDUOIQRPQ6EWp7AQc31YGtfBF68OwI7XxA6DWNeqYCpFrOA14D_45Yw5abLks_HHl_wdSfR2l6gIPs_1oYNs5Hr_DLcgOvAKDmNpE2)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF10r1FUVTxCa4wE3JS0dyZOn-6SZUgLmf9OXkhwgTDSdoy4qwAbS1X4Y31h6NVYvKLm_et5qk-hOaE2AErebfshumuZIC4mex4U5wBJmYgZAp-KnJoEekIi-b4pA-XUK9Qd2TUWKHiH8BIyT6qc8OBMZB-ZmQA3sZv-0Sj2_PwQ)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESWwHEIkXX_dTw6Km7YpG5eDkURSmE6-fruLoitMYW48s6Ri7MX8zDdUPPEf7ROOnDTwopqOFlO5OHWHdBFk-yW3xcBae4FP-LOkarGxNOpIKLBFUjev4wS4-Eb0w)

### Core Ingredients & Mechanism

- **Dihydromyricetin (DHM):** Both brands heavily feature DHM (derived from *Hovenia dulcis* or vine tea) as a primary ingredient. DHM interacts with GABA receptors in the brain to help buffer the "GABA rebound" (anxiety, restlessness, and poor sleep) that happens as alcohol leaves your system.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF10r1FUVTxCa4wE3JS0dyZOn-6SZUgLmf9OXkhwgTDSdoy4qwAbS1X4Y31h6NVYvKLm_et5qk-hOaE2AErebfshumuZIC4mex4U5wBJmYgZAp-KnJoEekIi-b4pA-XUK9Qd2TUWKHiH8BIyT6qc8OBMZB-ZmQA3sZv-0Sj2_PwQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXTC-uFJSyMRyhcN42wxTvh2S-8CFoAtWfIVGrdzHoWReeZ7NWrnkxODauQctYYxxV5QO-SPHq8GFcrB3r0nq0IfFweZmniT9EWdgeXnB81A8MTkpX4pBO7ceNu5XqpnGRcw)[[3]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/Dd60s6kFvXa/)
- **Liver Support & Acetaldehyde Breakdown:** Both include compounds meant to support the body's processing of acetaldehyde (a toxic alcohol metabolite).
	- **Cheers Restore** typically features a combination of high-dose DHM and **L-cysteine** (an amino acid that binds to acetaldehyde).
	- **No Days Wasted DHM Detox** combines DHM (around 1000 mg in some profiles) with L-cysteine, milk thistle, prickly pear, and a B-complex/electrolyte blend.[[1]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DcAqDH6KduG/)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXX0oZ0FjWPXU8B1UXBsw9hk0j21lj70KIdeStFoLKxUf2eMFMxs4jpLCisCuGGRVas06dwFRFrPA_Su7rUnb2kveoWSQgRteFJLiabAWW5H1nyXW_6slCSuWc7CQigkaBp1uTnIZj90Lie)[[3]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/Dd60s6kFvXa/)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESXQHEIkXXInTI1JyhOnsp5kFWAyp6yxQFh_CSw2uPP7vR8oUTlfA9AvxTAUTRp8nddlDHsqYQBJXQtJQH2aPSl3KV2OSh2Hk26EsvJs2C01nJfzz60YTh7a5R1d559w)

### Timing & Usage

- **Cheers Restore:** Recommended as **three capsules** taken right after your last alcoholic drink or before going to bed.
- **No Days Wasted:** Formulated to be taken either before, during, or right after drinking (often marketed around their signature "9AM Detox" or DHM detox packets/capsules).[[1]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/Dd60s6kFvXa/)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESXQHEIkXXInTI1JyhOnsp5kFWAyp6yxQFh_CSw2uPP7vR8oUTlfA9AvxTAUTRp8nddlDHsqYQBJXQtJQH2aPSl3KV2OSh2Hk26EsvJs2C01nJfzz60YTh7a5R1d559w)

### Scientific Evidence & Studies

- **Cheers** has published/sponsored open-label observational data on its product (reporting minor self-reported improvements on 1-to-10 scales, though independent reviewers note a lack of large, placebo-controlled human randomized controlled trials).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESWwHEIkXX_dTw6Km7YpG5eDkURSmE6-fruLoitMYW48s6Ri7MX8zDdUPPEf7ROOnDTwopqOFlO5OHWHdBFk-yW3xcBae4FP-LOkarGxNOpIKLBFUjev4wS4-Eb0w)
- **No Days Wasted** , like most over-the-counter hangover supplements, relies on the theoretical mechanisms of its individual components (like DHM and L-cysteine) rather than dedicated published human clinical trials on the finished formula itself.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESWwHEIkXX_dTw6Km7YpG5eDkURSmE6-fruLoitMYW48s6Ri7MX8zDdUPPEf7ROOnDTwopqOFlO5OHWHdBFk-yW3xcBae4FP-LOkarGxNOpIKLBFUjev4wS4-Eb0w)
- Medical authorities like the [Cleveland Clinic Health Essentials](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXqkcG2y8u2rcZaIISyjUjUqbn8Aq-Z9UVFTa7DchX2ytzrQoRJVjjRzUMby7hbeCVaLo93957eEkGKK1QhPE08i1r0Ohtu9VYVr3ElJ5Yfa4yomaMuPqIHEJgvI7HqgfCeb3-bgIUHMkJ) note that robust clinical evidence for hangover "cure" pills is sparse, and primary prevention still relies on moderation and hydration.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXqkcG2y8u2rcZaIISyjUjUqbn8Aq-Z9UVFTa7DchX2ytzrQoRJVjjRzUMby7hbeCVaLo93957eEkGKK1QhPE08i1r0Ohtu9VYVr3ElJ5Yfa4yomaMuPqIHEJgvI7HqgfCeb3-bgIUHMkJ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXX7PEbeNwNj9_cz4cSbq3DmFr9oeUrGaxNR0nOmqy04SAQV3cKsK610bmriVrDUOIQRPQ6EWp7AQc31YGtfBF68OwI7XxA6DWNeqYCpFrOA14D_45Yw5abLks_HHl_wdSfR2l6gIPs_1oYNs5Hr_DLcgOvAKDmNpE2)
